protocols.title: Ecnoglutide (10 mg) Dosage Protocol — source reference
protocols.purpose: Individual-page schedule and handling details, transcribed as a research/educational reference
protocols.evidenceNotes: Secondary commercial source; the details below are the source's own statements, not independently verified clinical guidance. Trial schedule reported as weekly SC: 0.6–1.2 mg/week in type 2 diabetes trials; 1.2, 1.8, or 2.4 mg/week in phase 3 obesity trial. 10 mg vial + 2 mL is stated as reconstitution math. The page describes China approval but research-grade product is not the approved medicine.

schedule.description: Source reports 0.6–1.2 mg/week in diabetes trials and 1.2, 1.8, or 2.4 mg/week in obesity trial arms.

regimen.notes: Dose range combines distinct trial contexts; it is not a titration instruction. Research vials are not approved product.
